results.reason: The video clearly shows the person picking up the blue cap and the O-ring, then carefully placing the O-ring into the groove of the blue cap.
The person is shown taking the blue cap with the O-ring and threading it onto the black manifold by hand until it is snug.

The person picks up the wrench but does not use it to tighten the cap. Instead, they put the cap and wrench down and then place the manifold into a plastic bag. The step of tightening with a wrench is not performed.
